scope: Bundled adult men's classical human games from international events and selected domestic master tournaments. Women's, youth, rapid/blitz and conflicting-clock records are excluded. Games ending before numbered move 20 are omitted; private imports are not filtered.
method: Conservative exact source-name matching, including expired sanctions and criticism notices. A name match is an exclusion rule, not a claim that a tournament participant is the sanctioned person. Two anonymized minors in the 2025 notice cannot be identity-matched. No claim of universal absence of misconduct is made.
userConfirmedAlias: Daniel identified the Singapore player he calls 'Andy Wo' as 吴宗翰. Wu Zonghan is displayed with that user-provided search alias.
minimumLengthNote: A numbered move is one Red/Black turn pair. A record with 39 half-moves reaches numbered move 20 and is retained; records with 38 or fewer half-moves are excluded regardless of result.
